title: Mr Puniverse
build: Mastertronic cassette, Novaload, from the TOSEC raw tape (2016-11-11)

tools.emulator: plus4emu 1.2.11 (git 939e652) with kit/c16/codemap.patch, built without libsndfile, in the kit's server

accuracy.note: 60 hand-written comments and 20 of the 25 room comments
every routine ported and checked against the game's code, alone and in lockstep; no comment in the listing needed correcting

exclude: runtime: nothing of the game is loaded below $0800. Zero page and pages 3 and 5, which hold the game's variables (cleared by new_game from $0345) and the KERNAL's (the key code at $C6, the SHIFT flag at $0543); the stack; the KERNAL's vectors at $0314-$0315, which setup_machine points at irq; and the leftovers of the Novaload loader in pages 1 to 3

not the game's: row 18's colours, the line between the play area and the panel, as the loading screen left them. The game reads none of them; pause_check writes six for PAUSED (paused_colours), and the rest stay unseen under the blank character $D6 that setup_machine puts in every cell of the row
not shown: the 24 bytes after the screen's last colour, which nothing writes; as loaded they hold the pattern of memory nothing had written

runtime: the switch states and the object tables (switch_state to shot_lo), which draw_room clears for every room. As loaded, $0FE8-$0FFF hold the pattern of memory nothing had written, $1001-$100C the BASIC line 0 SYS6900 that names the game's start, and the rest zeros
not the game's: 77 bytes between the tune's second voice and the code, which nothing reads; after one stray byte they hold the pattern of memory nothing had written
not the game's: 843 bytes between the title's dot path and the strings, which nothing reads, mostly the pattern of memory nothing had written
runtime: characters $78-$7D, the player as drawn, which merge_player rebuilds on every pass of the main loop
runtime: merge_player's work buffer, where copy_under_glyphs puts the scenery behind the player (where characters $FA-$FF would be)
